---
title: "What's been tested"
---

*Written for version 0.1.5. Last updated 10 November 2026.*

## Installing

| Check | Result | How |
|---|---|---|
| Claude manifest and marketplace are valid | Passed | `claude plugin validate` with Claude Code 2.1.322: one warning, no icon. With `--profile directory` (the checks Anthropic's plugin directory applies), the first version also lacked a README and a license; both were added on 10 November 2026 and it now passes, still with the icon warning. |
| Claude installs the plugin and loads the skill | Passed | Added the repository folder as a local marketplace, installed `figure-design@figure-design`, and confirmed the skill `figure-to-interactive` loaded. |
| Codex lists and installs the plugin | Passed | Same, with Codex CLI 0.167.0: the plugin showed as `installed, enabled`, version 0.1.5, with the skill in its cache. |
| Installing straight from GitHub | Passed | Repeated both installs from `VagishHemmige/figure-design` on GitHub, using the pull-request branch before it was merged: Claude Code loaded the skill, and Codex showed the plugin as `installed, enabled`. |
| One-line Claude Code install (`--marketplace`) | Passed | `claude plugin install figure-design --marketplace VagishHemmige/figure-design` from the main branch, Claude Code 2.1.322, after the first merge: added the marketplace and loaded the skill. |
| Installs copy only the plugin | Passed | After moving the plugin into `plugin/` (#21), installed from the GitHub branch in fresh Claude Code and Codex configurations: each cache held only the three manifests, `LICENSE`, `README.md` and `skills/`, with none of `site/` or `.github/`. |
| Claude app (web, desktop, Cowork) | Not yet | |
| ChatGPT Plugin Creator from this repository | Not yet | The plugin was first built in ChatGPT, not from this repository. |

## The workflow itself

The plugin comes from the maintainer's own figures, including the TransplantID workflow; its [lessons](reference/style.qmd#lessons-from-earlier-figures) record what went wrong along the way. It has not been tested in a structured way, and no one else has used it yet.

## This site

First published by the Publish website action on 10 November 2026 with Quarto 1.8.25, and checked live. Moved to Quarto 1.12.1 the same day (#21): rendered with both versions, every page's text is the same apart from a new "Skip to main content" link and the site title, which 1.8.25 left out of the desktop sidebar; no page scrolls sideways at phone width. The workflow figure on [How it works](how-it-works.qmd) was checked at desktop and phone widths; at phone width its one-line descriptions are small, so the page repeats every stage in text.
